messages.content:
The writer's note about it, in their words: r/WarriorCats 的提问帖。我刚开始读 Darktail’s Judgment，想问 Darkpaw 在月亮石那一段，还想说说我的看法。
The writer's English post (Reddit 提问帖):
<<<
I’m on the early chapters of Darktail’s Judgment, and I get a little bit confused about why StarClan didn’t show up when Darkpaw was at the moonstone and he got really miserable and furious about it.

Ravenpaw said StarClan had travelled with the Clans and left the forest sky, and it would be hard / not worth it to get back here for a distant little kittypet who wants to join the Clans. But it was mentioned in the book that it was a overcast day, so without the moonlight it makes sense that they couldn’t reach StarClan back then when the Clans were still in the forest. (Could someone tell me if there was a similar case in the other books that the night sky’s cloudy when a cat was at the Moonstone? Or do StarClan have the power to clear the clouds if they want to communicate?)

And Darkpaw didn’t try again on a clear day; he just chose to transform himself into Darktail👿 instead.
>>>

They are fixing this part of it: "hard / not worth it"
The problem the tutor saw there: hard 表示能力上做不到，not worth it 表示不值得去做，两者读法不同，一个是说做不到，一个是说不愿意。这需要作者自己决定想表达哪一种，否则读者会误解星族没出现的原因。
Asked what they mean, they wrote: "hard 表示能力上做不到，not worth it 表示不值得去做，两者读法不同，一个是说做不到，一个是说不愿意。这需要作者自己决定想表达哪一种，否则读者会误解星族没出现的原因。"

fine: true when what they wrote says the problem is not real (the part already says what they mean, or the tutor misread it), so the part can stay as it is; false when they are telling you what they mean.
reading: what they mean, as one clear Simplified Chinese (as used in mainland China) sentence (keep their meaning, do not add to it).
reply: to them in Simplified Chinese (as used in mainland China), one short sentence, informally: confirm what they mean, or, when fine, agree that the part can stay as it is.
The writer may write to you in any language; whatever they write in, everything you write for them is in Simplified Chinese (as used in mainland China).
Reply with JSON only: {"fine":false,"reading":"","reply":""}

result.text: {"fine":false,"reading":"作者转述的是导师的意见：\"hard\"表示能力上做不到，\"not worth it\"表示不值得做，两者含义不同，需要作者自己决定想表达哪一种，否则读者会误解星族没有出现的原因。","reply":"那你是想表达星族是做不到去，还是觉得不值得去呢？"}
